tables.name: projects
body: created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: project_members
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
role text NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('owner','maintainer','runner','viewer'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: applications
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
platform text NOT NULL CHECK (platform IN ('android','ios','web'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: app_builds
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, application_id) REFERENCES applications(project_id, id)

tables.name: environments
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: execution_nodes
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('online','offline','draining'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: resource_profiles
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
platform text NOT NULL CHECK (platform IN ('android','ios','web'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: execution_resources
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
platform text NOT NULL CHECK (platform IN ('android','ios','web'))
kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('device','simulator','browser_slot'))
status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('ready','offline','unauthorized','draining'))
fence_counter bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (fence_counter >= 0)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, node_id) REFERENCES execution_nodes(project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, profile_id, platform) REFERENCES resource_profiles(project_id, id, platform)
CHECK ((platform = 'web' AND kind = 'browser_slot') OR (platform <> 'web' AND kind IN ('device','simulator')))

tables.name: test_suites
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
test_type text NOT NULL CHECK (test_type IN ('ui','performance','joint'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, application_id) REFERENCES applications(project_id, id)

tables.name: suite_versions
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, application_id, suite_id) REFERENCES test_suites(project_id, application_id, id)

tables.name: test_tasks
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
lifecycle text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (lifecycle IN ('draft','ready','archived'))
lock_version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (lock_version > 0)
updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, application_id) REFERENCES applications(project_id, id)

tables.name: task_revisions
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
test_type text NOT NULL CHECK (test_type IN ('ui','performance','joint'))
readiness text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (readiness IN ('draft','validated'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, application_id, task_id) REFERENCES test_tasks(project_id, application_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, environment_id) REFERENCES environments(project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, application_id, build_id) REFERENCES app_builds(project_id, application_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, application_id, suite_version_id) REFERENCES suite_versions(project_id, application_id, id)
CHECK (readiness = 'draft' OR (build_id IS NOT NULL AND suite_version_id IS NOT NULL))

tables.name: test_runs
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
platform text NOT NULL CHECK (platform IN ('android','ios','web'))
state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK (state IN ('queued','dispatching','running','finalizing','completed','errored','cancelled'))
lock_version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (lock_version > 0)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, application_id, platform) REFERENCES applications(project_id, id, platform)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, application_id, revision_id) REFERENCES task_revisions(project_id, application_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, application_id, parent_run_id) REFERENCES test_runs(project_id, application_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, resource_id, platform) REFERENCES execution_resources(project_id, id, platform)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, profile_id, platform) REFERENCES resource_profiles(project_id, id, platform)
CHECK ((state = 'completed' AND outcome IS NOT NULL) OR (state <> 'completed' AND outcome IS NULL))
CHECK (state NOT IN ('running','finalizing','completed') OR (resource_id IS NOT NULL AND started_at IS NOT NULL))
CHECK (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= created_at)
CHECK (started_at IS NULL OR started_at >= created_at)
CHECK (ended_at IS NULL OR started_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= started_at)

tables.name: debug_sessions
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('opening','active','closing','closed','lost'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, resource_id) REFERENCES execution_resources(project_id, id)
CHECK (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= created_at)

tables.name: resource_leases
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, run_id, resource_id) REFERENCES test_runs(project_id, id, resource_id)
CHECK (released_at IS NULL OR released_at >= created_at)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, debug_session_id, resource_id) REFERENCES debug_sessions(project_id, id, resource_id)
CHECK ((run_id IS NOT NULL) <> (debug_session_id IS NOT NULL))

tables.name: run_components
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('ui','performance'))
state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','running','completed','errored','cancelled'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, run_id) REFERENCES test_runs(project_id, id)
CHECK ((state = 'completed' AND outcome IS NOT NULL) OR (state <> 'completed' AND outcome IS NULL))

tables.name: case_results
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
attempt integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (attempt > 0)
outcome text NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('passed','failed','skipped','errored'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, component_id) REFERENCES run_components(project_id, id)

tables.name: artifacts
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('screenshot','ui_tree','video','log','trace','metric_series','report_json','report_html','other'))
availability text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available' CHECK (availability IN ('available','missing','expired'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, run_id) REFERENCES test_runs(project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, run_id, component_id) REFERENCES run_components(project_id, run_id, id)

tables.name: metric_summaries
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
statistic text NOT NULL CHECK (statistic IN ('median','p95','mean','min','max'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
UNIQUE (project_id, component_id, metric_key, metric_version, scope, window_key, statistic)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, component_id) REFERENCES run_components(project_id, id)
CHECK ((value IS NULL AND missing_reason IS NOT NULL) OR (value IS NOT NULL AND missing_reason IS NULL))
CHECK (value IS NULL OR (sample_count > 0 AND value > '-Infinity'::float8 AND value < 'Infinity'::float8))

tables.name: baselines
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, application_id) REFERENCES applications(project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, environment_id) REFERENCES environments(project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, application_id, suite_version_id) REFERENCES suite_versions(project_id, application_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, profile_id) REFERENCES resource_profiles(project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, source_component_id) REFERENCES run_components(project_id, id)

tables.name: gate_policies
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, application_id) REFERENCES applications(project_id, id)

tables.name: gate_evaluations
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
mode text NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('original','reanalysis'))
verdict text NOT NULL CHECK (verdict IN ('passed','failed','not_tested'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, component_id) REFERENCES run_components(project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, policy_id) REFERENCES gate_policies(project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, baseline_id) REFERENCES baselines(project_id, id)
CHECK (verdict <> 'not_tested' OR reason_code IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: run_events
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (project_id, run_id) REFERENCES test_runs(project_id, id)

tables.name: audit_events
body: project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

table_comments.projects: 产品级隔离单元，Android、iOS、Web 应用归属于同一项目。
table_comments.project_members: 复用身份提供方，以项目角色授权，不在业务库保存登录口令。 角色必须由后端检查；project_id 外键不等于行级访问控制。
table_comments.applications: 目标端属于应用，不为每种端复制一套任务和报告表。
table_comments.app_builds: 固定待测构建；移动包与 Web 部署均采用同一版本记录。
table_comments.environments: 保存各环境的非敏感配置，实际站点地址可随环境区分。
table_comments.execution_nodes: 宿主 Agent 与可用适配器，初期按项目独占。 宿主凭据不入 capabilities；首期不设计跨项目共享节点池。
table_comments.resource_profiles: 不可变的可比性档案：系统、设备或浏览器、采集器、分辨率、指标版本。 档案内容变化新增记录，不覆盖旧记录；性能比较还须校验应用、场景和指标口径。
table_comments.execution_resources: 真机、模拟器或浏览器槽位。每个实例只承载一个活动运行。 Web 并发通过多个独立槽位表示；资源重新建档须在无活动租约时处理。
table_comments.test_suites: 登记代码维护的 UI 用例或性能场景，不把脚本正文塞进数据库。
table_comments.suite_versions: 固定仓库、提交及选择器，旧运行可追溯到当时的用例。
table_comments.test_tasks: 用户可编辑的逻辑任务；不存通过或失败结果。 Web/iOS 未接入时只能是 draft；计划能力不能用设备数据冒充已就绪。
table_comments.task_revisions: 每次保存新增不可变修订；运行只引用已验证修订。 只有字段完整不代表可运行；适配器能力、套件类型及配置 schema 仍由提交事务验证。
table_comments.test_runs: 一次提交或重跑对应一行，保留执行状态、最终结论和当时配置。 终态只追加新运行或新试算，不改原始结论；这种不可变性及状态转换须由后端写入边界实现。
table_comments.debug_sessions: 人工设备控制使用短期调试会话，与自动运行竞争同一资源租约。 只读预览不占独占租约；会发送输入、冻结采集等操作按宿主冲突规则受控。断线不能立即释放资源。
table_comments.resource_leases: 保留运行或调试的独占历史，用 fencing token 拒绝过期执行者。 部分唯一索引保证每实例、运行或调试会话最多一条未释放租约；超时回收仍需 Agent 隔离旧进程。
table_comments.run_components: 一次运行下的 UI/性能子结果。联动共用运行和租约，分别保留结论。
table_comments.case_results: 每个用例的执行尝试独立保存，可区分用例重试与整次重跑。 后端只接受 UI 组件的用例记录，校验 case_key 属于固定 suite_version。
table_comments.artifacts: 保存文件元数据和私有存储键，截图、日志、录像、曲线均通过此表归档。 文件先写临时键并校验成功，再提交元数据；无法做到数据库与文件原子提交，需幂等补偿。
table_comments.metric_summaries: 按指标、统计窗口和统计量保存查询所需的小体积摘要。 采样率、单位换算、窗口边界属于适配器契约；原始 series 单独归档，不逐点写业务库。
table_comments.baselines: 不可变的对照版本；源运行和全部可比性信息一并保留。 来源组件的应用、场景、环境、profile 和完整性须由创建基线事务验证；不靠跨表 CHECK。
table_comments.gate_policies: 平台持有门槛，适配器负责正确的测量与统计。
table_comments.gate_evaluations: 原始判定与后续试算分开保存；改规则不会覆盖历史结论。 同项目外键不保证规则与基线适用当前应用；服务必须检查完整可比性。
table_comments.run_events: 状态变化、步骤标记、接入事件按运行顺序追加，支持断线续看。
table_comments.audit_events: 记录谁修改配置、发起运行或调整规则，不承载完整业务数据。 只追加；审计主体与实体是否合法由授权后的业务事务写入。
